entrypoint.do: let app = (if (($env.AIRLOCK_APP_DIR? | default '') != '') { $env.AIRLOCK_APP_DIR } else if ('services/airlock/tsbifrost.ts' | path exists) { 'services/airlock' } else { ((^mise where github:bonisoft3/mecha | str trim) | path join 'services/airlock') }); exec deno run --node-modules-dir=auto --allow-net --allow-env --config ($app | path join 'deno.json') ($app | path join 'tsbifrost.ts')

dockerfile.do: sh -c 'd="${DENO_DIR:-/root/.cache/deno}"; s=/deno-store; k="$(sha256sum deno.lock */deno.lock */*/deno.lock deno.json */deno.json */*/deno.json package.json */package.json 2>/dev/null | sha256sum | cut -d'\'' '\'' -f1)"; mkdir -p "$d" "$s"; for sub in remote npm jsr; do if [ -d "$s/$k/$sub" ]; then mkdir -p "$d/$sub" && cp -a "$s/$k/$sub"/. "$d/$sub"/ 2>/dev/null || true; fi; done; (deno cache --frozen --node-modules-dir=auto tsbifrost.ts) || exit; t="$s/.tmp.$$"; rm -rf "$t"; mkdir -p "$t"; for sub in remote npm jsr; do if [ -d "$d/$sub" ]; then mkdir -p "$t/$sub" && cp -a "$d/$sub"/. "$t/$sub"/ 2>/dev/null || true; fi; done; rm -rf "$s/$k" && mv "$t" "$s/$k" 2>/dev/null || rm -rf "$t"; find "$s" -mindepth 1 -maxdepth 1 ! -name "$k" -exec rm -rf {} + 2>/dev/null || true'
